worldcombat.skill.discharge.summary: Lets electricity burst out of the body: foes in the ring around the user (airborne or grounded) are all zapped and may be paralysed; the wide style scans once more shortly after, hitting whoever stays inside. Overcharge narrows and strengthens it, dropping the echo.
worldcombat.skill.discharge.use.0: Zap a whole ring when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.discharge.use.1: An indiscriminate sweep that also hits airborne foes
worldcombat.skill.discharge.use.2: Paralyse the foes pressed against you
worldcombat.skill.discharge.use.3: Push foes out of the ring with the echo
Arcs burst from the body: each foe in the ring takes about %1$s damage; airborne and grounded targets are both hit. The target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
The electric ring covers %1$s blocks around the user; the wide style scans again after %2$s s, and whoever stays inside takes about %3$s more.
A hit target has a %1$s paralysis chance.
worldcombat.skill.discharge.overcharge.o: Overcharge on: the ring shrinks to ×0.72, main damage about 28%% stronger and paralysis about 35%% more likely, hitting at most 3 targets, but there is no second scan: wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks.
Overcharge off (wide): a wider ring hitting up to 8 targets and adding a delayed echo, for lighting up a group at once.
worldcombat.skill.discharge.timing: Cast on the space within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.discharge.growth.0: At level %1$s the discharge rises to %2$s power, the ring to %3$s blocks, and the paralysis chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.discharge.preference.o: On: a narrower ring that hits harder with a higher paralysis chance and no echo, with a longer wind-up and cooldown, for punching through one tough target. Off: a wider ring with a delayed echo, for lighting up a group.
worldcombat.skill.discharge.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion walks in instead of discharging; higher opens earlier but lets foes step away first.
With this on, the companion raises Discharge when another foe stands within 3.5 blocks of the target, so one burst catches the group; off keeps the normal attack order.
